why: Second tests round for slice 2 of docs/plan/quests/mock-cloudflare-PLAN.md, in next/, after the plan's 2026-11-16 amendment (signed at eb7e56100 on fabrikalfa/mock-plans; the first round read 14e9b3134). Decision 0095 is in force: Waits.ts and Dispatcher.ts hold only the contract, and their live layers live in WaitsLive.ts and DispatcherLive.ts. So every law that named Waits.layer or Dispatcher.layer now reads the live layer from the sibling file: readers.laws M1 and M2 read their live members from WaitsLive.layer and DispatcherLive.layer; connection.test.ts and error-cause.test.ts provide WaitsLive.layer under connectionLayer; reload.laws L12's ask helper provides DispatcherLive.layer under control. door.integration.test.ts in next/apps/fabrika is a tests row now: the connectionLayer it builds gets WaitsLive.layer, loaded in its beforeEach from the package export @kampus/libfabrika/workers/WaitsLive, as it loads the gateway. recordPartImplementation (record.ts) and ProcessObject.implementation (ProcessObject.ts), which the first round used, are the names the amended plan gives. Red now, against main: readers.laws fails to load (Cannot find module ./Dispatcher.ts); connection and error-cause fail to load (Cannot find module ./WaitsLive.ts); reload.laws fails to load (Cannot find module ./DispatcherLive.ts); door.integration fails all 153 laws in its beforeEach (./workers/WaitsLive is not exported from @kampus/libfabrika); alarm.laws, ObjectService and entry-flows.laws are unchanged this round and stay red as the first round recorded. M11 (the folder's vi lock) stays out of this sweep, so no lock block was written.

note: The plants needed product names that do not exist on main, so they ran on a scratch build written only to run them, split from the first round's: Waits.ts and Dispatcher.ts as contracts only (Dispatcher.ts also holds the ControlRequest schema its contract speaks in), WaitsLive.ts and DispatcherLive.ts each exporting layer, connection.ts and ConnectionObject.ts providing WaitsLive.layer, brain.ts providing DispatcherLive.layer where it runs control, the two References and the WebCrypto reads in runtime.ts, the implementations in record.ts and ProcessObject.ts, and package.json exports ./workers/Waits, ./workers/WaitsLive and ./workers/DispatcherLive. Every law was green on that build first: readers.laws 39, connection 11, error-cause 12, alarm.laws 2, ObjectService 3, entry-flows.laws 6, reload.laws 11 and door.integration 153. tsc --noEmit passed on it for libfabrika and for the fabrika app, with no cast or disable in a law. Each plant broke one line, ran its one law, and was restored by copy; the scratch build was then removed and the product files restored from copies of main, and git status showed only the five test files. The door law ran in this box (the 0178 guard allows a cloud box since PR 1508).
